Indian stock market news today · Ripple's top 9 stories · 15 Nov 2026
Indian markets are shut today; the watchlist and colour codes are for the next session, Monday 16 Nov.

1. Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed ahead of pricing on 18 Nov; it seeks up to $64.4bn — Bloomberg / TradingView
2. SBI Research now expects the RBI to hike by 25 bp on 4 Dec, not 50 bp, even with inflation at 6.09% — Business Today / ANI
3. Nvidia reports on 17 Nov without Jensen Huang: guidance is $108bn revenue and options price a ±10.6% move — FourWeekMBA / Morningstar / Nvidia
4. Markets price an 88.5% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike in December, with 11.5% on a half-point move — Bitcoin.com via CryptoTicker / CNN
5. Foreign investors pour about ₹66,300 crore into Indian stocks in November after two months of selling — Millennium Post (PTI) / Multibagg
6. Banks power the week: Nifty Bank jumps 3.71% as the Nifty gains 0.63% to 25,144 and the Sensex 0.73% to 81,592 — TradingView (Moody's/Mint) / Upstox
7. Brent ends a second losing week at $95.84 as OPEC+ output rises and the dollar index climbs to 103.17 — EnergyNow / FinanceFeeds
8. India beat Asia-Pacific by 7 points in October as funds pulled $31.8bn from Taiwan and $14.6bn from Korea — Multibagg / 5paisa
9. India's September-quarter growth is seen at 7.35–7.8% ahead of GDP data at the end of November — Deccan Herald / Devdiscourse

Swipe for each story's numbers, tone and who moves Monday: green = the news points up, red = the news points down, grey = watch. Summaries of published reports; sources named on each card. Not investment advice.

Save this for Monday's open, send it to a friend who tracks the market, and follow @ripple__stories for the brief every morning.
